info.title: KnowKit HTTP API
info.description: Host authentication precedes Scope construction and input validation. No tenant from body or path. Host supplies current identity and policy; every application boundary retains authoritative lifecycle and access checks. Mutations use durable core idempotency, never an HTTP response cache. Exact repeats replay accepted metadata; incompatible payload or expected epoch conflicts return 409. Unknown and unavailable remain distinct 503 outcomes; retryable follows owner policy. Disclosure and previews return only committed Usage-backed evidence. Disclosure attempt replay returns metadata without plaintext. Request-ID must be a ULID or is replaced. JSON body limit 262144 bytes; version upload JSON limit 1403000 bytes and decoded upload limit 1048576 bytes. JSON-compatible YAML; generate installable resources with packages/http/bin/generate.php. Denied/POLICY_CHANGED on mutation is the optimistic-conflict 409 exception; the envelope preserves denied. On disclosure POLICY_CHANGED remains 403. All origin refs are opaque catalog metadata, never fetch targets.

hostAuth.description: Host-owned authentication integration; credentials never supplied in JSON.

hostScopeHash.description: Trusted opaque SHA-256 supplied by the host; never recomputed or retagged.

errorCode.description: Wire error code kept in its approved original case: lower snake_case (scope_mismatch) or UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (POLICY_CHANGED, RETRYABLE_LOCK_TIMEOUT). Mixed case is rejected; no case conversion is applied.

purpose.description: Host business purpose such as lesson.read; never an Operation value.

textLocatorFields.description: Open tagged page/segment union; wrap with unevaluatedProperties=false.

Status409.description: Incompatible, epoch, revision, idempotency or schema conflict
